## Commit message example format
```
Implement draw_line_flat/gourad

This includes:
- init_system 0x004C3F10
- init_input 0x0043B950
- init_global 0x004C4D70
- memclr 0x00502D70
- line_work_init 0x004C3C60

And added ... to the GameTable.
```
